sentences.en: Do your parents agree to your becoming a flight attendant?
sentences.zh: 你的父母同意你当空姐吗？

sentences.en: Just where have you been loitering around without your attendants?
sentences.zh: 你到底在哪里鬼混，连个伴儿都不带？

sentences.en: At the same time Ismo jumps and baffles the attendants.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，Ismo 跳了起来，把服务员都搞糊涂了。

senses.zh: 服务人员；侍从，随从；护理者；随员，助手
伴随的，随之产生的；伺候的；陪伴的；到场的

mnemonic: 词根记忆：attend（照顾）+ant（人）→餐馆照顾顾客的人→服务员
